summary: Electrical and Computer Engineering PhD (University of Oklahoma, 2025) with undergraduate teaching experience in computer programming, communication systems, and wireless communications; additional laboratory, student-project, and research mentoring experience. Prepared to contribute to course instruction, precepts, laboratory learning, assessment, and office hours in computing, networking, and related data-intensive ECE subjects.
